_meta.description: Maps M3 Schemes variables to Spectrum equivalents. Keys are M3 variable paths (within the M3 collection). Values describe the Spectrum match or suggested fallback.

statuses.exact: Direct name match — Swap Variables plugin handles automatically
statuses.fallback: No direct match — fallback is the closest Spectrum equivalent

Schemes/Secondary Container.reason: secondary-container not in spectrum sys.color; falls back to parent color family

Schemes/On Secondary Container.reason: on-secondary-container not in spectrum sys.color; falls back to on-secondary foreground

Schemes/On Tertiary.reason: on-tertiary not in spectrum sys.color; on-primary is closest light foreground

Schemes/Tertiary Container.reason: tertiary-container not in spectrum sys.color; falls back to parent color family

Schemes/On Tertiary Container.reason: on-tertiary-container not in spectrum sys.color; on-surface is closest dark foreground

Schemes/On Error.reason: on-error not in spectrum sys.color; on-danger is semantically equivalent (both are foreground on error/danger)

Schemes/On Error Container.reason: on-error-container not in spectrum sys.color; on-danger is closest foreground for error states

Schemes/On Background.reason: on-background not in spectrum sys.color; on-surface serves the same role as primary text on neutral backgrounds

Schemes/Surface Tint.reason: surface-tint not in spectrum; M3 surface tint is derived from primary

Schemes/Scrim.reason: scrim not in spectrum sys.color; shadow is semantically equivalent (both are dark overlays)

Schemes/Inverse Surface.reason: inverse-surface not in spectrum sys.color; on-surface is the closest dark neutral

Schemes/Inverse On Surface.reason: inverse-on-surface not in spectrum sys.color; surface is the closest light neutral

Schemes/Inverse Primary.reason: inverse-primary not in spectrum sys.color; primary is the same hue family

Schemes/Primary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent from spectrum; primary-container is the closest lighter tone

Schemes/On Primary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent; on-primary is closest foreground

Schemes/Primary Fixed Dim.reason: Fixed variants absent; primary is closest mid-tone

Schemes/On Primary Fixed Variant.reason: Fixed variants absent; on-primary-container is closest dark foreground in the primary family

Schemes/Secondary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent; secondary is closest match

Schemes/On Secondary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent; on-secondary is closest foreground

Schemes/Secondary Fixed Dim.reason: Fixed variants absent; secondary is closest mid-tone

Schemes/On Secondary Fixed Variant.reason: Fixed variants absent; on-secondary is closest foreground

Schemes/Tertiary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent; tertiary is closest match

Schemes/On Tertiary Fixed.reason: Fixed variants absent and on-tertiary missing; on-primary is closest light foreground

Schemes/Tertiary Fixed Dim.reason: Fixed variants absent; tertiary is closest mid-tone

Schemes/On Tertiary Fixed Variant.reason: Fixed variants absent and on-tertiary-container missing; on-surface is closest dark foreground

Schemes/Surface Dim.reason: surface-dim not in spectrum; surface is closest neutral background

Schemes/Surface Bright.reason: surface-bright not in spectrum; surface is closest neutral background

Schemes/Surface Container Lowest.reason: surface-container-lowest not in spectrum; surface-container-low is nearest elevation step

Schemes/Surface Container High.reason: surface-container-high not in spectrum; surface-container is nearest elevation step

Schemes/Surface Container Highest.reason: surface-container-highest not in spectrum; surface-container is nearest available step
